recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is. Do not add redundant status prose or status codes for FHIR-25926 unless Patient Care opens a new issue that explicitly changes the current AdverseEvent.status versus AdverseEvent.actuality split.
issue_request: FHIR-25926 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked where to represent the status/outcome of the adverse event itself, resolved that AdverseEvent.status is the correct element, and required the definition to say "The current state of the adverse event or potential adverse event" with a comment clarifying that this is not regulatory/quality reporting and not the outcome of the patient's condition.
initial_application: Commit c31023666df8a405c7dd87ba90542d2eb32b7154 applied J#25926 to the old AdverseEvent spreadsheet by changing the status definition/comment and adding J#25926 committee notes. The 2021 source rework carried that text into source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml and the mapping exception file.
additional_context: AdverseEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source still contains the requested FHIR-25926 definition and both required comment sentences. Later Applied issue FHIR-36009 appended a clinical-trial clarification to the same comment, which is compatible with FHIR-25926 and does not reverse the distinction between event status, reporting status, and patient-condition outcome. The seed comment mentioned discussion of an averted/near-miss status code, but that was not part of the final FHIR-25926 resolution and current AdverseEvent models actual versus potential events separately with AdverseEvent.actuality.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was necessary because the current authoritative AdverseEvent source already satisfies the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: The same 2020 AdverseEvent WGM/application commit addressed outcome binding and helps explain why FHIR-25926 distinguishes event status from patient-condition outcome.
A later Applied issue appended the clinical-trial assessment sentence to the same AdverseEvent.status comment without changing the FHIR-25926 definition or core distinction.
